title: U.S. Jobless Claims Rise to 225,000, Marking Four-Month High Amid Labor Market Resilience
author: James O'Connor
excerpt: U.S. jobless claims rose to 225,000 for the week ending May 30, the highest since February, but layoffs remain historically low. Labor market data suggest resilience despite economic headwinds.

title: United States Inflation Hits Highest Level in Nearly Three Years
author: Michael Chen
excerpt: U.S. inflation accelerated in April to its highest level in nearly three years, increasing pressure on the Federal Reserve and raising concerns about tariffs and consumer costs.

title: European Firms Say China Remains Too Important to Abandon
author: Finance Desk
excerpt: A new EU Chamber survey found growing confidence among European companies operating in China despite escalating trade tensions and geopolitical concerns.

title: Snowflake Shares Jump After Strong Earnings and Massive AWS AI Deal
author: Finance Desk
excerpt: Snowflake raised its annual revenue forecast after strong earnings driven by enterprise AI demand and a new $6 billion cloud infrastructure partnership with Amazon AWS.

title: More Americans Say Their Finances Are Worse Than a Year Ago, Fed Survey Finds
author: David Smith
excerpt: A Federal Reserve survey shows more Americans believe their financial condition has worsened compared with a year ago, while inflation expectations, debt concerns and economic uncertainty continue to weigh on households.

title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Posts Record Quarter as AI Infrastructure Demand Soars
author: Sarah Wu
excerpt: HPE reported record quarterly revenue as demand for AI infrastructure, servers and networking products surged, prompting the company to raise its financial outlook.

title: Singapore GDP Growth Beats Forecasts as AI and Electronics Exports Soar
author: David Smith
excerpt: Singapore’s economy expanded faster than expected in early 2026 as AI investment, electronics exports, and financial services growth offset geopolitical and inflation concerns.
